card.name: The verb occur after events
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb occur (occur, occurs, occurred, occurring) right after a noun for an event, such as reactions, seizures or errors. Also fires on similar verbs like happened.

modes.description: The -ing form follows a noun and is followed by 'in other settings'.
